study.notes: STUDY: Dutour 2016 (Diabetes Obes Metab 18:882-891), the full paper of the group's 2016 conference abstract, reached through the institutional route; Tables 1 and 2 and sentences of the Methods and Results copied into work/fulltext/companion/dutour2016_exenatide_mri_tables.txt; prospective randomised trial, 44 obese adults with type 2 diabetes uncontrolled on oral agents, exenatide (dose increased to 10 ug twice daily after 4 weeks; dose_mg 0.01 per injection) vs reference treatment intensified according to local guidelines, 26 weeks, 3T MRI and 1H MRS; n 22 per arm in Tables 1 and 2 (six participants dropped out or were withdrawn, the tables keep 22 per arm); primary outcome the change in ectopic fat (EAT, MTGC, HTGC, PTGC), the biomarkers here are secondary (prespecified_endpoint FALSE); Table 2 gives mean (SD) at week 0 and week 26 per arm with the p of the time by group interaction (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5, the interaction p recorded in the row notes and not used); the text and Table 1 give mean (SEM); pct_weight_change -5.08 computed by the session: exenatide -5.5 kg on a baseline of 104 kg (Table 1) is -5.29 percent, reference -0.2 kg on 95 kg is -0.21 percent, corrected -5.29 - (-0.21) = -5.08; industry_funded TRUE: supported by a grant from Lilly, Amylin Pharmaceuticals and AstraZeneca (ESR MB001-029); fasting glucose, insulin and HOMA-IR were calculated after excluding patients on sulphonylureas with the resulting n not given, so no rows are written for them; rob_overall some_concerns

Results text: HbA1c change -0.7 ± 0.3 vs -0.7 ± 0.4 percentage points (mean ± SEM), p = 0.29; study population baseline HbA1c 7.5 ± 0.2 percent (n 44), per arm baseline not captured

json.design: prospective randomised trial, exenatide vs reference treatment, 26 weeks, 44 randomised, single centre (Marseille)
json.reason: full paper of the group's 2016 abstract reached through the institutional route; replaces the abstract read (2 rows) with 12 rows (the two abstract rows kept, ten Table 2 rows added by the imputed change route)
other_markers: fasting glucose, fasting insulin and HOMA-IR in Table 2 computed after excluding sulphonylurea users with the n not given (no rows)

rob.justification: S (full paper, tables and sentences captured): randomisation method and concealment not in the captured text (D1); open design with a reference treatment arm, imaging reader blinded (D2); six of 44 dropped out or were withdrawn while the tables keep 22 per arm, handling not captured (D3); MRI, MRS and laboratory outcomes (D4 low); no registration seen in the captured text (D5)

doubts: Table 2 states mean (SD) while the Methods state mean (SEM); the Table 2 magnitudes (hsCRP 9.96 ± 11.01, leptin 31.41 ± 22.38) are only consistent with SDs, so Table 2 values are read as SDs and the text values (HbA1c, weight, HTGC) as SEMs
n per arm for Table 2 is taken as 22 although six participants dropped out; the analysed numbers are not given
pct_weight_change derived by the session from the kg changes and Table 1 baseline weights
